svg.aria-label: Fhemt ? architecture: Angular frontend with Firebase sign-in calls a Node.js + Express API (Redis cache, MongoDB, Cloudinary). Node.js and the Python FastAPI AI microservice exchange events through RabbitMQ (answer.submitted, material.uploaded, mastery.updated). The AI microservice uses Redis for tutor memory, Qdrant to search the course, Groq to write answers and Mailjet for emails.
svg.title: Fhemt ? — architecture
svg.text: ① A student answers a question
② A teacher uploads a course PDF
③ A student asks the tutor
Quick actions answer right away. Slow work (AI, emails, statistics) goes through RabbitMQ, so the student never waits.
